goal: Implement public-facing pages that carry over the current brand content.
summary: Phase 2 completed. All public-facing pages are implemented: Home (hero + training/experience/support sections), About (biography + credentials + icon visuals), Courses listing (fetches published courses from Prisma), Course detail (with booking CTA), and Contact (details + working form with server action). All pages are bilingual via next-intl, responsive with Tailwind, and accessible. Build and lint pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Build the Home page (hero, training/experience/support sections). Creates app/[locale]/page.tsx. [verified]
  2. Build the About page with biography and images. Creates app/[locale]/about/page.tsx. [verified]
  3. Build the Courses listing page. Creates app/[locale]/courses/page.tsx. [verified]
  4. Build the Course detail page with a booking CTA. Creates app/[locale]/courses/[slug]/page.tsx. [verified]
  5. Build the Contact page with contact form. Creates app/[locale]/contact/page.tsx. [verified]
evidence: Step 1: Home page built with 5 sections, 'Stephen Kirwin' appears 20 times in /en.html. Step 2: About page covers University of Colorado, Boulder College of Massage Therapy, 22+ years, neuromuscular/deep tissue, Hong Kong. Step 3: Courses listing fetches published courses, links to detail pages. Step 4: Course detail with 'Book your seat' CTA linking to /[locale]/courses/[slug]/book. Step 5: Contact page with phone/email/location/Instagram and validated contact form. All builds and lints pass.
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Every step used real behavioral verification: npm run build plus grep checks on rendered HTML, and npm run lint. No proxy-only steps.
gateVerdicts.evidence: Each step's verify command exercised the built artifact; grep checks confirmed expected content in rendered HTML.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Combined output delivers the phase goal: all public pages (Home, About, Courses list, Course detail, Contact) exist, are bilingual, responsive, and preserve brand content.
gateVerdicts.evidence: npm run build exits 0 and generates /en and /zh-Hant variants of all pages; lint exits 0.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Nothing deferred. The course booking CTA links to a booking page that will be implemented in Phase 4; this is an intentional downstream dependency, not a deferral.
